name: Yeast glycolysis (Pritchard 2002) as a black box
notes: CONSOLIDATION component (stopping-rule test): a second real kinetic glycolysis model. Reuses the sbml machinery unchanged; its glucose + pyruvate reconcile with Teusink AND the FBA box by canonical ChEBI identity + actual-atom formulas (a 3-way identity cross-check). OPEN by construction, same as Teusink: a partial 2-port projection (glucose in, pyruvate out) whose balancing intracellular species (H+, H2O, NAD(H), ATP) are not medium ports, so it exchanges those atoms with an unmodelled intracellular compartment.

validity.note: kinetic model; unit compartment assumed (amount~conc), consistent with Teusink
